title: Graduate Engineer
abstract: Join an industry leader and gain valuable post-grad experience working on major projects in the geotechnical engineering space!
bullets: Join Australia’s leading geotechnical engineering company
screening_questions: Are you willing to undergo a pre-employment medical check?

content_text:
Keller Graduate Program – 2027
Intake, to commence February 22027
- Australia’s leading geotechnical engineering company
- Mentoring program with colleagues who are experts in their field
- Contribute to major projects and building the future of Australia
About Keller Australia
We have delivered industry leading foundations and ground improvement solutions to the building, construction, and mining industries in Australia for over 60 years. With a wide range of challenging and dynamic projects, join Keller to build the foundations for the future of Australia and we can help you build your career. 
Who are we looking for?
We are on the lookout for a recent or upcoming Civil Engineering Graduate to join the Keller family as part of our 2-year Graduate Program. This unique opportunity gives Graduates hands on experience across all aspects of our organisation and equips you with real life skills to kick start your career in engineering.
The best part? At the end of the program, permanent positions are considered as part of the Keller Engineering Team!
What does the program entail?
2-year training across Pre-Construction and Operations
Membership with Engineers Australia as part of their Graduate Program 
Experience in assisting on major projects throughout Australia  
What will make you a good fit for our team?
- You are a recent Engineering Graduate (within the last 2 years) in Civil or Geotechnical Engineering 
- You have a passion for the industry and looking to get firsthand exposure to all aspects of an organisation 
- You are willing to travel, our graduate program will allow you to visit our various offices and projects sites across Australia, giving you valuable hands-on experience and firsthand knowledge from our expert team 
- You have your Australian Drivers License and your own transport
- You can commit to 2 years full-time employment within the program
- You have full, unrestricted working rights in Australia
What makes us stand out?
- Our culture - We are a diverse and inclusive organisation where differences are valued. We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities to apply
- Our projects – We employ a variety of geotechnical techniques across a range of interesting projects across the country 
- Our expertise – Our team have a broad range of skills with vast experience within the industry, and they are eager to mentor and assist with career development
How to apply
If you love what you have heard and are ready to join the Keller Team, apply online today with your CV, covering letter and a copy of your academic transcript. 
To learn more about us, visit www.keller.com.au
Please note Keller have a strong commitment to health and safety, a pre-employment medical (including a drug and alcohol screen) will be required for the successful candidate.
